resources.string: Camera access is used to detect hand gestures. Camera frames are processed locally for gesture detection.
Android requires a visible notification while Air Control uses the camera in the background. It lets you stop Air Control at any time.
Air Control needs its Accessibility service so it can swipe, tap and scroll in other apps for you. Open Settings → Accessibility → Installed apps → Air Control, then switch it on.
Camera permission is required to detect hand gestures.
Enable the Air Control accessibility service first, then return here and tap START.
Camera permission was denied. You can allow it in the app settings.
Air Control started. You can now leave the app.
Could not open Accessibility settings. Open them manually from Android Settings.

• All hand tracking runs on this phone.
• Camera frames, hand images and hand landmarks are never uploaded, stored or shared. Air Control does not even request internet access.
• The Accessibility service is used only to perform the gestures you make (swipe, tap, scroll, drag, zoom). It does not read the content of your screen, passwords or private app data; it only learns which app is in front so it can apply the right profile.
• Air Control only watches the camera while the "Air Control Active" notification is showing. Stop it any time with STOP AIR CONTROL or the notification button.

Hold your hand about 30–50 cm from the FRONT camera and rest it for a moment first (Air Control waits for a short pause before it trusts a swipe).

→ SWIPE RIGHT
Move your hand quickly left → right: next image.

← SWIPE LEFT
Move your hand quickly right → left: previous image.
After a swipe pause briefly; the return movement is ignored.

👌 PINCH
Touch thumb and index fingertip while the other fingers stay open: click at the Air Cursor.

👌👌 DOUBLE PINCH
Two quick pinches: double click.

🖐 OPEN PALM
Hold an open palm still for a moment (SCROLL MODE), then raise or lower your hand from where it started. Keep it raised to keep scrolling.

✊ FIST
Hold a fist for ½ s to press and hold at the cursor, move your hand to drag, open your hand to release.

🤏 TWO-FINGER ZOOM
Show only thumb + index (an "L"), hold, then move them apart (zoom in) or together (zoom out). Zoom only works in apps that support pinch-to-zoom.
Offer to start Air Control after device restart

Android does not allow the camera to start by itself after a reboot. If this is on, you will get a notification after restart – tap it to start Air Control. Accessibility is never enabled automatically.
Optional. Some phone makers stop background apps aggressively. If Air Control stops by itself, set it to “Not optimized / Unrestricted”. You are never forced to do this.
Changes apply instantly, even while Air Control is running. Use the Debug screen to see live values.
The same gesture can do different things in different apps. Unknown apps use the Gallery profile.
Shown while Air Control is using the camera to detect gestures.
Hand gesture control is running. Camera frames stay on this phone.
Accessibility service is off - gestures can not control other apps. Open Air Control.
Tap to open Air Control and start hand gesture control.
Lets Air Control perform the swipes, taps, scrolls, drags and zooms that you make with hand gestures in front of the camera. It does not read the content of your screen.
